claim_extraction.method: Split K.3 body into atomic claims

aggregate_confidence.calculation: Average of all individual claim scores

validation_process: Step 1: Parse K.3 body into atomic claims
Step 2: Calculate confidence for each claim individually
Step 3: Check each claim against per_claim_minimum threshold
Step 4: REJECT any claim below threshold
Step 5: Remove low-confidence claims from body
Step 6: Recalculate aggregate with remaining claims
Step 7: If aggregate still < aggregate_minimum, trigger full regeneration

The workflow MUST halt if the 'Clerk' phase fails to extract a complete and structurally valid data scaffold (recipient profile and route decision).
v10.20: HyDE enrichment MUST NOT fabricate employers or dates (LIC-QA-041, LIC-QA-066).
v10.20: Per-claim confidence MUST be ≥ get_confidence_threshold('per_claim_minimum') before aggregation (LIC-QA-106).
v10.20: Aggregate confidence MUST be ≥ get_confidence_threshold('aggregate_minimum') before generation approval (LIC-QA-104).
v10.20: Team descriptions MUST match whitelist with ≥ get_confidence_threshold('team_whitelist_minimum') similarity (LIC-QA-105).
v10.20: Metrics MUST have ≥2 context keywords within ±20 words and ≥ get_confidence_threshold('context_coherence_minimum') coherence (LIC-QA-107, LIC-QA-043).
v10.20: No placeholders allowed in final output (LIC-QA-067).
v10.20: Job title MUST appear in first 50 words when job_confirmed=true (LIC-QA-075).
v10.21: ALL length constraints MUST be retrieved from 2.5.global_message_constraints via API.
v10.21: Only 3 routes are valid: CONNECTION_REQ, INMAIL, FOLLOW_UP.
v10.22: ALL tunable parameters MUST be retrieved from 2.5.global_message_constraints via API (47 total parameters).
v10.22: Routing decision tree MUST follow 5 deterministic nodes with zero ambiguity.

7.pipeline.description: Defines the three-phase pipeline for generating LinkedIn outreach. v10.22 uses global constraints and hardened routing throughout.

phases.name: The Clerk: Deterministic Data Scaffolding
phases.description: Programmatically extracts all factual data from user inputs (recipient profile, routing decisions) and required files.

phases.name: The Artist: Grounded Generation
phases.description: The creative LLM is invoked for all generative tasks (subject, body, CTA), governed by the rules in the 'creative_brief'. Uses route-aware constraint resolution and hardened routing validation.
phases.v10.22_enhancement: Now uses hardened routing decision tree with 5 deterministic nodes and complete SSOT integration

phases.name: The Assembler: Final Rendering & Validation
phases.description: Programmatically combines the factual scaffold with the creative prose and runs all final validation gates before rendering the final message. All length validation uses global constraints and comprehensive E2E testing.
phases.v10.22_enhancement: All constraint validation references 2.5.global_message_constraints, comprehensive test suite ensures 100% pass rate
